name: P-004 independent D-006 terminal integration failure and bounded coverage census
summary: The mandatory integration-only sweep FAILED. All seven selected workspace tasks produced complete output blocks; the observed terminal file census contains 1405 unique task/file pairs. This does not prove complete selected-file enumeration or current final-source acceptance: the selector explicitly emitted unenumerated wide-run coverage, the shared tree moved, 298 tests were skipped, and complete source/environment identities were not captured. No quarantine, waiver, retry, final acceptance or shipment is inferred.

counterSemantics.failed: Non-quarantined failing task count, not failing file or assertion count.
counterSemantics.timedOutTasks: Additive count of failing tasks whose captured result contains recognized Vitest timeout signatures. Not an extra task, a watchdog-kill count or proof of a resource cause.
counterSemantics.testsExecuted: Pinned testsExecutedFrom sums passed and failed segments of each task's last Tests summary. It excludes the separate one-expected-fail segment.
counterSemantics.expectedFailExplanation: The one-test difference is accounted for by the explicit expected-fail summary segment. It is not a skip, missing file, extra task or fabricated execution.

coverage.selectionReason: Every task was a wide-run without an explicit related-file list. Terminal observed file rows are not a retrospective selected-file manifest.
coverage.skipIdentityScope: All observed skipped counts are attributed to exact task/file rows. The 179 emitted case names are retained with line references; the remaining 119 case identities are explicitly unavailable from this run's output, not reconstructed from current source.

sourceIdentity.scope: Preflight pins cover package.json, affected-tests.mjs, pc-heavy.sh, report-library.ts, goal-owner-report-reference.ts, coordination/tools/send.ts, send.test.ts and report-library.integration.test.ts only.
sourceIdentity.auditIsNotRunEnd: The fingerprint audit is a later read. It is not a measurement of the complete source tree, transitive import graph or environment at the run's end.

environment.scope: These are recorded launcher identities, not a complete per-suite runtime, database, fixture, dependency or service fingerprint.

omissions: The seven wide-run task selections do not enumerate their selected file populations.
298 collected tests were skipped; ten complete files were skipped and 45 files contain skips.
119 of the 298 skipped case names were not emitted; exact per-file missing counts are retained.
No complete run-end source/test/import-graph fingerprint exists for the 1405 observed files.
Database versions, per-suite fixture identities and full runtime/dependency/environment fingerprints were not recorded by this preflight.
The failure census is evidence for repair placement, not a proven root cause for each failure.
Shared-tree drift and three stale failure paths prevent a single-current-final-source acceptance claim.

Current R5/causal and author R1-R3 mutation bindings have testRun=unknown with test-run-worktree-not-clean; current source/test dimensions and passed grading audits do not discharge that provenance gap.
nextRequiredEvidence: Accountable repairs and their focused verification, appropriate clean/verified mutation provenance, and an explicitly sequenced final-source D006 verdict. Preserve this failure bundle; do not duplicate a live sweep or relabel this run as passing.
rawArtifactResolver: Resolve local-state: beneath XDG_STATE_HOME, defaulting to $HOME/.local/state. These copied immutable verification-harness artifacts do not depend on the original /tmp logs. SHA256 and byte pins were independently read back before this census was published.

methods: Read the exact committed counter and selection writers at the preflight revision.
Strip ANSI and partition all seven complete AFFECTED_TASK_OUTPUT blocks.
Parse singular/plural Vitest file summary rows and retain line identities, status and skipped counts.
Reconcile the 1405 observed unique task/file rows with every task's Test Files totals and the 124 canonical failing-file entries.
Retain reported skipped-case names and exact unavailable-case-name counts per file.
Reconcile expected-fail accounting separately from the canonical executed and skipped counters.
Verify eight preflight file pins against the actual start commit and preserve later audit hashes as a separate scope.
Copy the terminal logs and bounded census into the existing local-state verification-harness evidence rail and re-read their byte and SHA256 pins.
